messages.subject: Global Mining Executive | Government Relations, ESG & External Affairs Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Popham,

Rocco Mercier's retained-search focus on mining leadership makes this a particularly relevant introduction.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, where my portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates across mining and natural resources where operating strategy depends on regulatory credibility, government relationships, social licence, responsible development and coordinated execution across corporate and technical stakeholders. I am internationally mobile and open to expatriate appointments, with Saudi Arabia and the UAE as priority markets alongside broader global mining opportunities.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration for relevant current or future mandates.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
